title: FICTIONAL — Early Career Science Conference Travel Award
eligibility_text: Applicants must be based in the United States. Applicants must be employed as a research professional or enrolled as a graduate student. Applicants must have earned their most recent degree no more than five years before the application date. Applicants must have an accepted oral presentation or poster for a scientific conference. The requested travel award must not exceed $1,000.

title: FICTIONAL — Enrolled Graduate Student Mobility Grant
eligibility_text: Applicants must currently be enrolled in a graduate degree program. Applicants must be based in the United States. The requested award must not exceed $600.

title: FICTIONAL — Mid-Atlantic Research Training Award
eligibility_text: Applicants must reside or work in Washington, DC, Maryland, or Virginia. Applicants must be either current research professionals or enrolled graduate students. The trip must be to a training workshop rather than to a research conference. The requested amount must not exceed $800.

title: FICTIONAL — Open Methods Dissemination Award
eligibility_text: Applicants must have an accepted presentation at a scientific meeting. Applicants must make the software described in their presentation publicly available under an MIT or Apache-2.0 software license. The amount requested must not exceed $1,200.

title: FICTIONAL — Postdoctoral International Exchange Fund
eligibility_text: Applicants must currently hold a postdoctoral research appointment. Applicants must provide an invitation letter from an international host laboratory. The requested amount must not exceed $2,000.

title: FICTIONAL — Community Science Outreach Microgrant
eligibility_text: Applicants must be based in the United States. The project must be a public-facing community science outreach or science education initiative. The funding request must not exceed $1,000.
